_comment: Edit this file to update project cards. Valid statuses: ongoing, completed, planned.
title: VeSpA: Vessel Spatial Analysis
description: Robust, reproducible, and scalable vessel-feature extraction from histological images, including vascular segmentation, morphology, spatial distribution metrics, and links to drug distribution modeling.

title: Imaging Mass Cytometry Analysis Workflows
description: Reusable Imaging Mass Cytometry workflows for channel preparation, panel generation, segmentation, feature extraction, cell phenotyping, and spatial biology analysis.

title: AI-assisted Tumor Microenvironment Analysis
description: Interpretable machine learning approaches for analyzing tumor microenvironment organization, immune neighborhoods, stromal context, vascular patterns, and candidate biomarkers.

title: Reproducible Computational Pathology Pipelines
description: Nextflow and HPC-ready workflows for transparent, repeatable processing of multiplex imaging and pathology datasets, including Steinbock-based segmentation and feature extraction.

title: Digital Pathology Biomarker Discovery
description: Quantitative tissue image analysis for candidate biomarker discovery, with emphasis on morphology, spatial organization, vascular features, and translational cancer hypotheses.
